project.name: ScamShield India
project.tagline: Protecting Indian Digital Citizens from Cyber Fraud, Malicious APKs, and Fine-Print Scams

targetAudience.primary: Elderly and first-time smartphone users in India with low tech/digital literacy
targetAudience.devices: Low to mid-range Android smartphones (320px–412px viewports)

coreDesignPrinciples: Clarity under panic: zero technical jargon, immediate color-coded verdict
Tactile accessibility: minimum 48px to 56px touch targets
Audio-first support: prominent native voice explanation playback
Zero friction: no login/signup walls; instant analysis

designSystem.theme: Sleek Dark Mode (Optimized for low-end AMOLED & battery saving)

verdictDanger.description: Used ONLY for confirmed scams, malware APKs, or phishing links

verdictCaution.description: Used for suspicious urgency tactics, unverified senders, or elevated APK permissions

verdictSafe.description: Used for verified legitimate Indian banking, telecom, or government entities

typography.fontFamily: Inter, Outfit, Noto Sans Devanagari, system-ui, sans-serif

screens.title: Universal Threat & APK Scanner
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen where users paste text, scan QR codes, upload screenshots, or check APK packages.

components.name: Header
elements: ScamShield India logo badge with security emblem
Prominent one-tap Language Selector pill (e.g., '🌐 हिंदी')
Navigation links: Privacy (DPDP Act) and Terms

components.name: Hero Trust Affirmation
elements: Headline: 'Check any message, link, QR, or Android APK'
Trust micro-badge: '100% Private • Zero Data Stored • Govt 1930 Integrated'

components.name: Unified Input Box
elements: High-contrast multiline text area with friendly Indian scam placeholder examples
Action toolbar: '📋 Paste Clipboard', '📷 Scan QR', '🖼️ Upload Screenshot', '📦 Check APK File', 'Clear'
Big Primary CTA: '🔍 Check Now (तुरंत जांचें)' (56px tall, high tactile feedback)

components.name: Loading & Feedback States
elements: Multi-stage animated progress card with status updates
Slow-connection banner (>8s): 'Still checking threat feeds...' with Cancel button
Error notice with 1-click 'Retry' button

components.name: Emergency Pinned Footer
elements: National Cyber Crime Helpline: 'Dial 1930 (Toll Free 24x7)'
Official reporting portal: cybercrime.gov.in

screens.title: Instant Verdict & Voice Advice
screens.purpose: Displayed immediately after analyzing text, links, or QR codes.

components.name: Verdict Banner
elements: Massive traffic-light status pill (RED Danger / AMBER Suspicious / GREEN Safe)
Plain-language explanation (zero technical jargon)
Confidence & Risk Score indicator

components.name: Voice Guidance Player
elements: Prominent audio button: '🔊 Listen in Hindi / हिंदी में सुनें'
Audio wave animation playing pre-synthesized native speech

components.name: Threat Category Tags
elements: Visual badge pills (e.g. 'Fake Electricity Bill', 'Lookalike Banking Domain', 'Urgency Pressure Tactics')

components.name: Action Checklist
elements: 1. Do not reply or transfer funds
2. Block sender on WhatsApp / SMS
3. Report immediately on 1930
Link to safety confirmation (/thank-you)

screens.title: APK Malware & Predatory Fine-Print Loophole Reader
screens.purpose: Displays dangerous Android permissions and warns against hidden predatory terms of service clauses in APK files.

components.name: App Identity & Risk Banner
elements: Package Name, Version, App Label, and Total Permissions Count
Critical Security Warning verdict if malicious trojan indicators are present

components.name: Dangerous Permissions Breakdown
elements: RECEIVE_SMS / READ_SMS (OTP Theft)
BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE (Screen Overlay / Banking Keylogger)
READ_CONTACTS (Predatory Loan Shark Blackmail)
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW (Fake Screen / Lock Screen Hijack)

components.name: Predatory Fine-Print Loophole Warnings
elements: Warning 1: Contact Harassment & Recovery Blackmail clause (shows quoted text excerpt)
Warning 2: Hidden Recurring Auto-Debit & Subscription Fees (shows quoted text excerpt)
Warning 3: Legal Recourse & Class-Action Waiver (shows quoted text excerpt)
Warning 4: Gallery & Camera Storage Scraping (shows quoted text excerpt)
Warning 5: Third-Party Data Resale (shows quoted text excerpt)

components.name: Action Recommendation
elements: High-contrast alert button: '🗑️ Uninstall or Delete File Immediately'

routes.title: Privacy Policy
routes.highlight: Zero-retention architecture complying with Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023

routes.title: Terms & Conditions
routes.highlight: Safety guidance disclaimers and emergency 1930 reporting protocols

routes.title: Safety Confirmation
routes.highlight: Positive cyber hygiene confirmation with 1-click WhatsApp family sharing card

routes.title: Custom 404 Error
routes.highlight: Friendly navigation back to scanner and quick 1930 emergency helpline access

deliverablesRequested: Enhanced tactile layout for elderly users with big touch targets
